action: Push EVT Level 1 certification into the charging systems and thermal management module — the next section after drivetrain. This is the module most relevant to fleet and commercial EV maintenance, which is the segment that will grow fastest as RoboRide and similar services expand. Log at least 10 study hours this month, up from the 6-8 hours I have been averaging. The RoboRide expansion is a signal that the timeline for needing these credentials is compressing. Ahead-of-pace is not enough. I want to be finished with Level 1 in the next 4-5 months, not 6. I will also ask Carlos whether he has any contact yet with fleet maintenance operators or EV service centers — not to job-hunt, but to understand what the actual hiring criteria look like for that work.
